full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the disposal of this petition are that the Hossain Ali, Kanchan Bibi, Hason Bibi, Asia Begum, Abdul Gafur Hawlader, the predecessor-in-interest of the petitioner Nos. 1(a) to 5(d), Ahmed Ali Talukder, Abdul Aziz Talukder and Adam Ali Talukder (the plaintiffs) instituted Title Suit No. 77 of 1987 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Jhalakati for declaration of title in respect of 1.38 acres out of 5.14 acres of land of S.A. Plot Nos. 591 and 593 of S.A. Khatian No. 311 and for further declaration that the judgment and decree passed in Title Suit No. 138 of 1969 is illegal, collusive and void. Their case, in short, is that Afaz Uddin, owned 5.14 acres of land who died leaving behind two sons and two daughters who inherited the same. Taking advantage of the plaintiffs minority during the last settlement operation, Jabed Ali, son of Rahman Ali in collusion with the settlement staff got the suit lands recorded in his name. Defendant Nos. 1-9 thereupon  instituted Title Suit No. 106 of 1986 in the Court of Munsiff, Jhalakati for declaration of title in respect of the lands in plot No. 591 of S.A. Khatian No. 311 and for recovery of possession. The defendant Nos. 2-5 having realised the defect filed a solenama on 8th September, 1986 admitting the plaintiffs' title of that suit. Kashem Ali and Sonai Bibi, son and wife of Rahman Ali thereupon instituted Title Suit No. 138 of 1969 for partition in First Court of Munsif, Barisal and obtained a decree on 22nd December, 1969 which was collusive. No summons of the said suit were served upon them and that they had no title in the suit lands. The said decree was forged and collusive, and the plaintiffs had no knowledge about the said decree. Respondent Nos. 1-3 also instituted Title Suit No. 34 of 1977 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Jhalakati for declaration of title in respect of 1.38 acres of land in the suit Khatian and for further declaration that the decree passed in Title Suit No. 106 of 1986 is illegal, void and collusive. The defence case of respondents is the plaint case of Title Suit No. 34 of 1987.
